module.name: mercury
module.summary: RTT/1 material analysis of mercury, focusing on triad compression, coherence collapse, bounded drift, and rapid regime transitions.
module.purpose: Provide a complete RTT-aligned structural, operator, coherence, drift, and regime analysis of mercury across solid, liquid, gas, and plasma states.

files.purpose: Defines mercury's RTT operators including temperature triads, coherence operators, drift operators, paradox operators, and resonance operators.
Visual and structural mapping of mercury's regime transitions (solid → liquid → gas → plasma) using RTT operators.
Applies Clarity operators (CE, CM, CS, CD, CX, CT) to mercury's coherence, drift, paradox, and triad-spacing behavior.
Walkthrough of RTT/1 triads (State, Dimensional, Measurement) applied to mercury’s resonance behavior.
Narrative synthesis explaining mercury’s behavior through RTT principles: triad compression, coherence collapse, drift bounding, and plasma access.
Provides a structured RTT/1 method for identifying, measuring, and validating regime transition points.
Explains SET triad (Spin, Elec, Temp) and RTT regime transitions in the context of supercapacitor behavior.
Compares T/C/D/Ω operators across mercury, gallium, and cesium.
